title: CarrierChannelModel
description: HX-241 carrier channel model output from XPOCK's physical wave propagation models. Describes how a wave propagates through a specific physical carrier medium. These are physical layer models only; HX-241 protocol logic is carrier-agnostic.

id.description: Unique identifier for this carrier model

capacity_bps.description: Channel capacity in bits per second

impairment_params.description: hx-sim compatible impairment parameters derived from this channel model

frequency_response.description: Complex channel transfer function H(f) - real and imaginary parts interleaved

frequency_grid_hz.description: Frequency grid in Hz for the frequency response

impulse_response.description: Channel impulse response h(t) - real and imaginary parts interleaved

time_grid_s.description: Time grid in seconds for the impulse response

hx241_mapping.rust_type: Physical carrier model (not part of HX-241 core protocol)
hx241_mapping.purpose: Estimate CarrierCapabilities and NetworkImpairment parameters for hx-sim
hx241_mapping.invariant: I-CARR-001 to I-CARR-005: HX-241 does not depend on specific carrier technology
